review.agent_ids: PRESENT - env.agents / env.possible_agents (a0, a1 = env.possible_agents), real PettingZoo Parallel API pattern, not hard-coded
review.parallel_aec_api: PARALLEL - env.reset(seed=...) returns (obs, infos) dicts keyed by agent; env.step(acts) takes a dict of actions and returns (obs, rew, terms, truncs, infos) dicts, the real PettingZoo Parallel API shape
review.action_spaces: ONTOLOGY_PZ = (NOOP, FIRE, UP, RIGHT, LEFT, DOWN) - distinct from and explicitly NOT interchangeable with the 1P ALE ontology (module docstring: 'ALE and PettingZoo action bytes do NOT share semantics')
review.observation_schema: Per-seat: seat_state() strips the raw 'ship' field and derives own_ship/opponent_ship by colour-matching pixels in the frame; seat_context() adds anticube/path_distribution features for non-OJ arms
review.reward_schema: vita_outcome, opponent_outcome, relative_payoff = vita_outcome - opponent_outcome, all per-decision
review.termination_truncation: checked per seat each step: 'if not env.agents or all(terms.get(s) or truncs.get(s) for s in terms): break'
review.synchronization_barrier: implicit in the Parallel API itself: env.step(acts) takes both seats' actions simultaneously and returns both seats' results together; no separate barrier code is needed or present
review.seed_handling: env.reset(seed=seed), single fixed seed per match, matching the 1P convention
review.trace_schema: well-defined per-decision row: corpus_id, t, state_id, vita_action, opponent_action, successor_state_id, outcomes, relative_payoff, seats, action_ontology_id, meta
review.mmr_schema: reuses src.fmo.mmr_root (the same primitive as the 1P episode MMR); leaf = SHA256('EPISODE_LEAF_V1', t, content_id(row))
review.frame_custody_hooks: ABSENT - e5_2p.py has no PNG/frame-capture integration; it was written for an earlier research comparison (E5-2P), not for competition video production. Would need new code (not a modification) to add frame-custody hooks.

claim_ceiling: This is a static code review only. No 2P runtime claim (PASS or otherwise) is made. This is a legitimate, useful, non-terminal state.
